snippet.title: Redhowl | Official Teaser
snippet.description:
*Redhowl* is a top-down social deduction game that immerses you in the world of Little Red Riding Hood. It’s an online multiplayer game for 4 to 15 players, developed by the independent studio *BENOM STUDIO.*

You’ll find yourself in Grandmother’s village, deep within the Redhowl forest. Far from the idyllic childhood tale… 

🐺 *Multiple roles, each with unique abilities.*
⚔️ *Three factions: the little hoods, the wolves, and the pathless.*
🕵️ *A game of teamwork, deduction, and manipulation.*

*Eager to see more?* Join our playtests on Discord or meet us during the Steam Next Fest.

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3873330
Join our Discord: https://discord.gg/yZn6vk7ATp
Follow us on Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/redhowl_game
Follow us on TikTok: https://www.tiktok.com/@redhowl_game
Follow us on Twitch (FR): https://www.twitch.tv/redhowlgame

*Teaser production*
Art Direction: Thomas BURGUET 
Storyboard / Video Editor: Thomas BURGUET
Co-Editor: Maxence HUME
Music: Florent MANZONI @florent_manzoni 
Sound design: Jordan BOUVIER and Florent MANZONI
Sound Mixing: Florent MANZONI
Developer: Jordan BOUVIER
